Looking at the candidates:

- **INV-00253** is for a different customer (CUST00221 / Dev Verma), so it should not be matched

The payment captures on 2026-09-16, which is:
- After INV-00051 was issued (2026-09-10) and before its due date (2026-09-25)
- After INV-00052 was issued (2026-09-11) and before its due date (2026-09-26)

Both INV-00051 and INV-00052 are valid candidates. However, this is a single payment of 5,000,000 paise, and I need to determine which invoice it pays for. The payment amount exactly matches one invoice (either one), not a combination.

Since the payment was made on 2026-09-16, it more likely corresponds to the invoice issued earlier (INV-00051, issued 2026-09-10) as a timely payment before the due date of 2026-09-25.
